sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Heals 20% of max HP every 5 seconds for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 30000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 30000
Only [Begrudging Bunny] Alverra can be used as Unlocking Potential material
